parameters.query: select jsonb_object_agg(key, value) as cfg from app_config;

-- "Find due contracts" node of workflow D (Postgres, Execute Query). No parameters.
-- Turn on "Always Output Data" so the workflow still finishes when nothing is due.
--
-- A contract is due when its notice deadline (end date minus notice days) is at most N days away,
-- for a threshold N in app_config.renewal_thresholds (default 90, 60, 30), and that threshold has
-- not been alerted yet. "At most" (not "exactly") means a missed day, for example the machine
-- being off, still gets its alert on the next run instead of never.
-- A contract gets ONE alert per run: the tightest threshold it fits (89 days left -> 90, 59 -> 60).
-- Contracts that already ended are ignored. A deadline already passed shows days_left < 0.
WITH today AS (
    SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date AS day
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT t::int AS threshold_days
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
             COALESCE((SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key = 'renewal_thresholds'), '[90, 60, 30]'::jsonb)
         ) AS t
),
contract_days AS (
    SELECT c.id AS contract_id,
           (c.end_date - c.notice_days) - today.day AS days_left
    FROM contracts c, today
    WHERE c.end_date >= today.day
),
picked AS (
    SELECT cd.contract_id, cd.days_left,
           (SELECT min(threshold_days) FROM thresholds WHERE threshold_days >= cd.days_left) AS threshold_days
    FROM contract_days cd
)
SELECT p.contract_id, p.threshold_days, p.days_left, c.contract_ref, t.name AS tool
FROM picked p
JOIN contracts c ON c.id = p.contract_id
JOIN tools t ON t.id = c.tool_id
WHERE p.threshold_days IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM renewal_alerts r
                  WHERE r.contract_id = p.contract_id AND r.threshold_days = p.threshold_days)
ORDER BY p.days_left, c.contract_ref;

-- "Claim alert" node of workflow D. Parameters in order: contract_id, threshold_days.
-- The alert is claimed BEFORE it is sent. The primary key (contract_id, threshold_days) lets only one run
-- insert the row; a second run (or an overlapping one) gets no row back and stops here, so a duplicate
-- alert is impossible. If sending fails the claim is released again (see release_claim.sql).
-- Returns the contract details used for the message and the Jira ticket.
WITH claimed AS (
    INSERT INTO renewal_alerts (contract_id, threshold_days)
    VALUES ($1::int, $2::int)
    ON CONFLICT (contract_id, threshold_days) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING contract_id, threshold_days
)
SELECT cl.contract_id, cl.threshold_days,
       c.contract_ref, t.name AS tool, t.vendor, c.seats, c.price_per_seat, c.billing_cycle,
       round(c.seats * c.price_per_seat * 12, 2) AS annual_value,
       c.start_date, c.end_date, c.notice_days, c.auto_renew, c.owner_email,
       (c.end_date - c.notice_days) AS notice_deadline,
       (c.end_date - c.notice_days) - (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date AS days_left
FROM claimed cl
JOIN contracts c ON c.id = cl.contract_id
JOIN tools t ON t.id = c.tool_id;

-- "Record alert" node of workflow D, runs after the Slack post worked.
-- Parameters in order: contract_id, threshold_days, jira_key (empty when there is no ticket).
UPDATE renewal_alerts
SET jira_key = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), jira_key),
    sent_at  = now()
WHERE contract_id = $1::int AND threshold_days = $2::int
RETURNING contract_id, threshold_days, jira_key;

-- "Release claim" node of workflow D, runs when the Slack post failed after retries.
-- Parameters in order: contract_id, threshold_days. Deleting the claim lets the next run try again.
DELETE FROM renewal_alerts
WHERE contract_id = $1::int AND threshold_days = $2::int
RETURNING contract_id;

-- "Insert dead_letter" node of workflow D. Parameters in order: contract_ref, threshold_days, error text.
-- One open row per contract and threshold, so a failing contract does not pile up rows day after day.
INSERT INTO dead_letter (workflow, node, payload, error)
SELECT 'D - Renewal alerts', 'Slack alert',
       jsonb_build_object('contract_ref', $1::text, 'threshold_days', $2::int), $3
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM dead_letter
    WHERE workflow = 'D - Renewal alerts' AND status = 'open'
      AND payload->>'contract_ref' = $1::text AND (payload->>'threshold_days')::int = $2::int
);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Build alert').item.json.contract_ref, $('Build alert').item.json.threshold_days, String($('Slack alert').item.json.error?.message ?? 'Slack post failed')] }}

value.items_out: ={{ (() => { if (!$('Record alert').isExecuted) return 0; let n = 0; for (let r = 0; ; r++) { try { n += $('Record alert').all(0, r).length; } catch (e) { break; } } return n; })() }}
value.notes: ={{ (() => { if (!$('Record alert').isExecuted) return 0; let n = 0; for (let r = 0; ; r++) { try { n += $('Record alert').all(0, r).length; } catch (e) { break; } } return n; })() + ' alert(s) sent' + ((() => { if (!$('Release claim').isExecuted) return 0; let n = 0; for (let r = 0; ; r++) { try { n += $('Release claim').all(0, r).length; } catch (e) { break; } } return n; })() ? ', ' + (() => { if (!$('Release claim').isExecuted) return 0; let n = 0; for (let r = 0; ; r++) { try { n += $('Release claim').all(0, r).length; } catch (e) { break; } } return n; })() + ' failed, will retry' : '') }}
